cues: The two orbitals pointing at the ligands, d x squared minus y squared and d z squared, rise: the e g set.
The three pointing between, d x y, d y z and d z x, fall: the t two g set.
The gap between them is the crystal field splitting energy, delta o.
The t two g set falls by zero point four delta o, the e g set rises by zero point six delta o, so the average energy stays the same.
